textNote: text: h = font size (em) in metres, capitals are 0.72 h; p = anchor at the vertical middle of the capitals (canvas textBaseline 'middle'), align = horizontal anchor, rot = deg CCW. dim: h likewise, optional tp = text middle when lifted off its default place. paths: several polylines in one entity, each a flat list x0, y0, x1, y1, ... Per sheet: linestyles (dash, gap, ...), hatch spacing and dimstyle in model metres; dxfOffset = where the sheet sits in the DXF, in mm. A sheet of kind 'section' is drawn in section coordinates: x = (p - section.origin) . section.right in plan metres, y = world Z; its rooms[].polygon likewise.
